process.heading: Made slowly,
process.imageAlt: Lelek Studio Berlin - ceramic process, wheel-throwing and intuitive handbuilding in the studio
process.body1: Each functional piece starts on the wheel - shaped, trimmed, glazed by hand. Wall objects are built differently: through intuitive handbuilding, form emerging from the material rather than the wheel.
process.body2: Small batches, slow process, made at Clay Stories Berlin. The glaze is applied by hand and fired at high temperature - the result is always slightly different from what was planned, and better for it.
